name: Crash zoom
source: Freefield (neuregex/freefield, MIT), adapted to Moonfactory's Wan 2.2 worker
description: A sudden, fast punch-in on the subject. Comic or shock emphasis.

prompt.fragment: crash-zooms in fast on the subject
prompt.compose: The camera {fragment}. prepended to the scene prompt; up to 3 moves joined with ', then ' in picked order (see composition grammar in presets-index.json).

fidelity: approximate: prompt-guided camera work on Wan 2.2, not a baked-in camera control. Freefield's lab note applies here too: one move holds best; with two or more the model does not always keep the order.

end_keyframe.detail: End keyframe = this crop window of the start frame, scaled back to full frame, made locally (ffmpeg) before the chain segment renders. Steers the move harder than prompt text alone.

keyframe_enhancement.fidelity: approximate: the end keyframe is an upscale of a crop, so the end of the move trades some sharpness for steering strength. Recipe spec only: the API dispatcher does not expose the firstlast lane yet; wiring is platform-pass work.

verification: Draft lane (Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B), benchmark balloon scene, seed 12345, preset prefix the only delta. Result: a gentle push only, subject scale +24% first-to-last frame spread evenly, no fast punch-in; the crash speed was not honored on this lane. Output: outputs/camera-preset-crash-zoom-draft-test.mp4 (960x1664, 16 fps, 5.06 s). For this move prefer the keyframe enhancement (0.40 crop window end keyframe) or Fun Camera conditioning over prompt text alone.
